steps.say: Step two: you tell the agent what to buy, in plain English.
The agent reads the shop's catalog and picks an item within your rules.

steps.text: A real order is created, ready for the buyer to approve at PayPal
steps.say: It creates an order. The buyer then approves it at PayPal, sandbox here, so no real money moves.
Every choice lands in the ledger, with its mandate check beside the payment status.
